verdict.rationale: Analytics on call volume, answer rate and missed calls is a fair question for a business phone platform, but the evidence documents no reporting or analytics dashboard. The closest items are MCP/API retrieval of call history and missed-call info per number. Those are raw data access, developer building blocks rather than per-number and per-teammate metrics with answer rates. The vague 'Spot issues before they cost your business' tagline does not describe a reporting feature.
